chunks: Which would envelope mankind. That would be a grievous affliction.
ai.seo_question: What is the 'grievous affliction' that will envelop mankind in Surah Al-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific afflictions preceding the appearance of Imam al-Mahdi (aj), serving as a divine warning to humanity before the final judgment. The 'grievous affliction' is understood not merely as physical pain but as a spiritual and societal collapse that envelops all people, emphasizing the universality of divine retribution.
